album.title: Northline Collection
album.label: EchoVerse Audio
album.collectionDescription: Built from cold peaks, dark timber, still water, moonlight, and that unmistakable North Idaho edge. Northline translates AeroVista’s visual language into a grounded outdoor form—mountains, lakes, snow, forest, reflection, and hidden apex geometry.

tracks.title: Northline
tracks.subtitle: The Signal
tracks.story: The lead signal for the collection. Northline moves through dark timber, high country, moonlight, snow, and the quiet work built behind the scenes.

tracks.title: Blue Divide
tracks.subtitle: Two worlds in one reflection
tracks.feel: Alpine night • cold water • moonlight • hidden apex
tracks.story: A moonlit alpine lake framed by steep peaks and dark timber. The reflection turns the landscape into a second world, with the hidden V appearing only when you stop long enough to see it.

tracks.title: Ridgeline
tracks.subtitle: The long view
tracks.story: A wide panoramic study of mountain country—snow-covered peaks, dark pine forest, mirrored water, and one continuous horizon.

tracks.title: Idaho After Dark
tracks.subtitle: Local code after the lights fade
tracks.feel: Moonlit • local • hidden details • North Idaho
tracks.story: The most overtly local chapter: full moon, layered peaks, dark forest, reflected water, and an Idaho mark almost hidden among the trees.

tracks.title: Powderline
tracks.subtitle: Gravity makes the decision
tracks.story: A steep mountain face cut by a sharp electric path through fresh white snow. The most physical and kinetic piece in the collection.

tracks.title: Source Code
tracks.subtitle: The system underneath
tracks.feel: Cryptic • structured • field mark • hidden meaning
tracks.story: Mountain, forest, water, contour lines, and apex geometry contained inside a precise field insignia. The closing chapter reveals the structure that was underneath the landscape all along.
